method: Scored from ER0–ER6 experiments; not a production decision.

A_native_elementor_identity.summary: Native element IDs survive text edit, reorder, and Elementor document API resave. Must include owner scope + field/control + nested-item keys for translation-unit granularity.
A_native_elementor_identity.determinism: high within a document when IDs present
A_native_elementor_identity.value_granularity: requires field/nested keys — widget ID alone insufficient
A_native_elementor_identity.uniqueness: intra-doc generally unique; cross-doc collisions proven (16 shared IDs across posts including intentional bp_* ids)
A_native_elementor_identity.copy_duplicate: page duplicate copies identical IDs — owner scope mandatory
A_native_elementor_identity.import_export: import preserves IDs from payload — collision risk without owner scope
A_native_elementor_identity.maintenance_cost: medium — Elementor version ID behaviour must be revalidated
A_native_elementor_identity.rendering_safety: depends on ER4 hooks (builder_content_data / widget render_content present)

B_aiml_identity_in_elementor_data.summary: Disposable probe showed _aiml_identity survived meta roundtrip and Elementor document save; title still rendered. Higher governance threshold NOT met for GO: update/import/copy policy incomplete; mutates Elementor-owned persistence.
B_aiml_identity_in_elementor_data.edit_stability: supported by evidence on disposable fixture only
B_aiml_identity_in_elementor_data.copy_duplicate: assumption requiring validation — may copy embedded IDs
B_aiml_identity_in_elementor_data.maintenance_cost: high — Elementor updates may strip unknown settings
B_aiml_identity_in_elementor_data.store_compatibility: compatible only with ADR ownership exception
B_aiml_identity_in_elementor_data.confidence: supported by evidence (probe); GO blocked by governance

C_structural_path.summary: Reorder retained element IDs but changed structural paths for 5/6 nodes — path identity breaks under sibling reorder.
C_structural_path.edit_stability: proven by experiment — FAIL for reorder

D_hybrid_native_plus_owner_field_hash.summary: Preferred research direction: owner scope + native element ID + control key + nested-item/_id + optional responsive suffix; source hash for stale detection only.
D_hybrid_native_plus_owner_field_hash.copy_duplicate: consuming-document-owned after copy; new owner key
D_hybrid_native_plus_owner_field_hash.template_ownership: definition-owned when stable template_id reference exists
D_hybrid_native_plus_owner_field_hash.import_export: owner remapped on import target document

E_adapter_or_unsupported.summary: Correct outcome for repeaters, loop-grid, third-party, dynamic, html/shortcode — either dedicated adapter or deny-list.
